headline: EnCap Flatrock Announces Sale of M6 Midstream to Williams for $5.5 Billion
summary: SAN ANTONIO, August 03, 2026-- EnCap Flatrock Midstream ("EnCap Flatrock") today announced the execution of definitive agreements to sell Momentum Midstream ("Momentum," "M6," or the "Company"), a leading independent midstream energy company of which EnCap Flatrock is a financial sponsor, to The Williams Companies, Inc. ("Williams") (NYSE: WMB) for up to $5.5 billion.
